description: Fetch the current weekly action plan for the merchant: a ranked list of typed actions (publish opportunity, retire stale bundle, reorder inventory, investigate drift, etc.) the merchant should take this week. Use this when a merchant asks 'what should I work on this week?', 'what's on my plate?', 'show me my weekly plan', or wants a summary of pending tasks before opening the admin. Merchant-ops surface: BigCommerce today; on other platforms merchants manage this from the admin, and the tool returns a clear not-available message.
name: get_weekly_plan
